sections.label: Prepare the root
sections.description: H on q0 prepares equal amplitudes for 0 and 1. All other nodes start at 0.

sections.label: Entangle the first branch
sections.description: The first CNOT creates a Bell pair. q0 and q1 now agree in every joint measurement.

sections.label: Branch in parallel
sections.description: q0 reaches the right branch q2 while q1 reaches its first leaf q3. Four nodes now share the same bit.

sections.label: Reach two more leaves
sections.description: The branches pass their correlations to q4 and q5. Only q6 still reads 0 with certainty.

sections.label: Complete the tree
sections.description: q2 reaches q6. The seven-qubit GHZ state yields all zeros or all ones, each with 50% probability. Delete this last CNOT to leave q6 at 0.
